name: LiteLLM
rootCause: SlowMist's CISO 23pds warned on X: "A major supply chain attack has hit LiteLLM (97M monthly downloads) via PyPI. Simply executing pip install litellm allows attackers to steal sensitive data: SSH keys, cloud logins (AWS/GCP/Azure), K8s configs, Git credentials, API keys, shell history, crypto wallets, and DB passwords."
